user.title: Choose an Echo Button
user.description: These Echo Buttons are already paired with this Home Assistant host.

pair.title: Pair an Echo Button
pair.description:
1. If the button is paired with an Echo, unplug that Echo for now.
2. Hold the Echo Button down until it glows **orange**. That takes 5–20 seconds; keep holding through any blue or green flashes.
3. Release it, then select **Submit**. The button stays in pairing mode for a couple of minutes.

progress.pairing: Looking for an Echo Button in pairing mode and pairing with it. This can take up to 45 seconds.

error.not_found: No Echo Button in pairing mode was found. Make sure it glows orange, then select Submit again.
error.pair_failed: Pairing failed. Put the button back into pairing mode (orange) and try again.
error.bluez_unavailable: Could not reach the Bluetooth service (BlueZ) on this host.

abort.already_configured: This Echo Button is already set up.
abort.bluez_unavailable: Could not reach the Bluetooth service (BlueZ). This integration needs a Bluetooth adapter on the Home Assistant host.

init.title: Echo Button options
init.description: After each short press, the button glows the toggle's new state color, then fades back. The button's own blue flash on press can't be turned off.

data_description.keep_awake: The button goes to sleep after 10 idle minutes. The next press only wakes it and isn't reported; it reconnects about 2 seconds later. With this on, Home Assistant asks the button for its status every 4 minutes so it stays awake. This likely drains the batteries faster.

play_animation.name: Play animation
play_animation.description: Plays a light animation on an Echo Button, then returns to the LED entity's steady color (or off).

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: List of up to 41 steps. Each has a color ([r, g, b] or "#rrggbb"), a duration in milliseconds (1–65535) and an optional fade (true fades into this step's color).

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: How many times to play the sequence (1–255).
